items.title: 📊 午间看点 | 沪指高开0.58%吐到只剩0.06%，创业板从+2.44%砍到+1.49%——但3862家上涨、0跌停
items.summary:
📊 午间看点 | 沪指高开0.58%吐到只剩0.06%，创业板从+2.44%砍到+1.49%——但3862家上涨、0跌停

兄弟们，今天上午这个盘面最有意思的地方，不是指数，是"指数跌了、账户涨了"。

先把上午的弧线拉一遍，别被红绿骗了。

▪️ 开盘：沪指+0.58%报3682.04，深成指+1.51%，创业板指+2.44%（2520.01），科创50+2.37%——集体高开，外围把火烧得很旺（隔夜道指+2.15%涨1104点、纳指+2.74%、费半+6.85%、韩国KOSPI高开4.6%直接触发程序化买盘暂停）。

▪️ 午收：沪指3662.81，+0.06%，最低3662.25——收在最低点上，全天振幅只有0.59%，也就是说开盘那0.58%的涨幅基本上原封不动吐干净了。深成指11229.66 +0.76%，创业板指2495.29 +1.49%（从2520.01回吐了25个点，涨幅砍掉四成），科创50 1270.14 +1.05%，科创综指+1.32%，北证50 900.22 +0.50%。

▪️ 量能：两市半日9603亿，三市9683亿，比昨天同时段缩了491亿。开盘第一个小时就缩371亿，财联社预估全天1.56万亿——昨天全天1.48万亿，这算不上放量，只能叫"没继续缩"。

▪️ 但结构完全反过来了：3862家上涨、1483家下跌，53只涨停，**0只跌停**，21只炸板，炸板率28%。上证50盘中翻绿，中证1000、国证2000明显跑赢。

记住这个对照——昨天（11/9）是"指数红、超3000家个股绿"，今天是"指数绿、3800多家个股红"。24小时之内，赚钱效应从指数里搬到了个股里。这不是护盘，这是**换仓**。权重被砸、题材虹吸，钱没跑，只是换了座位。

▪️ 谁在涨，涨得很硬

**传媒AI漫剧，今天唯一有共识的主线。** 文字媒体+8.61%（板块内2家全红）、其他数字媒体+7.37%、影视院线、AI语料、短剧互动游戏全线拉。华策影视20cm回封涨停，掌阅科技一字型+9.99%（换手14%、成交19.8亿），文投控股11天7板，慈文传媒、金逸影视、引力传媒、天威视讯、风语筑（+9.97%）一串涨停，华智数媒、百纳千成涨超10%。

催化是真东西，不是纯情绪：QuestMobile秋季报告说9月短剧视频App使用时长净增133.29亿小时、全赛道第一，断层领先第三名AIGC；10月海外短剧百强榜82部的主投平台是中国厂商（NetShort占63席、DramaBox占9席）；再叠中金11月8日那份"AI影视工业化"研报。这条线是"中国产能出海+AI降本"的组合，逻辑比纯题材扎实。

**机器人，催化最密集。** 机器人概念主力净流入67.41亿（24股涨停、1022股飘红），人形机器人单独61.91亿（12股涨停）。宇树科技+10%，市值逼近3200亿；福莱新材6天3板续创历史新高；光洋股份、锋龙股份、华培动力2连板；亿嘉和、豪能股份、泰尔股份涨停；维宏股份、安培龙、汉威科技涨超10%。

三重催化撞一起了——马斯克说特斯拉已在弗里蒙特工厂启动Optimus早期量产、2027年底左右开始向外部客户交付、初期成本跟电动车差不多；Anthropic发布Claude Fable 5.2，在RoboDojo双臂机器人测试里成功率64.9%，把GPT-6 Astra的29.8%甩开一倍多；再加上进博会上Hitch Open物理智能平台全球开源。产业、模型、政策三个方向同时给信号，这种共振不常见。

**算力硬件，隔夜映射最直接。** 电子行业主力净流入61亿+全场第一；半导体板块主力净流入32.57亿（全市场排名第2），板块涨1.71%；元件/PCB这条线——世运电路2连板、肯特股份和澳弘电子双涨停、协和电子涨停、迅捷兴+12%、沪电股份+7%。存储链HBM+2.14%、存储器+2.02%、长鑫存储+1.90%。

个股东方：新易盛主力净买入超13亿全场第一，中际旭创、东山精密、掌阅科技净流入居前；工业富联+12.42亿（+4.57%）、烽火通信+4.67亿（+6.78%）、中国卫星+4.01亿（+4.55%）。

还有一个容易被忽略的数字：通用设备主力净流入20.3亿，但板块只涨1.08%——资金在低位悄悄埋，还没拉。这种量价背离，是接下来几天值得盯的。

▪️ 谁在杀

油气最惨：中国石油-5%以上，中国海油、中海油服、中曼石油一起下。布油隔夜-6%报92.31，美油-5%报86.24，美伊谈判有实质进展，霍尔木兹的断供溢价一次性回吐。

昨天还是领涨冠军的煤炭，今天变提款机——晋控煤业、广汇能源、新集能源领跌，动力煤-1.14%。能源内部比价一塌，红利资金转头就去追AI了。这就是存量市场的跷跷板，昨天的强势板块就是今天的血包。

保险、港口航运、证金持股、电力、医疗美容、民爆全在跌幅榜。资金流也很直白：净流入电子、文化传媒、通信，净流出电新、交通运输、石油石化；个股云南锗业净卖超4亿、雪人集团、中国船舶、闽发铝业流出居前。碳酸锂早盘又跌1000元，报91100元/吨，锂电这条线短期没戏。

▪️ 上午走了个什么形态

我的定性就四个字：**权重失血**。

沪指振幅只有0.59%，开盘就是最高，一路阴跌，收盘压在全天最低点上方0.56点——这不是"高开横盘"，这是**单边回落**。而且砸盘的位置非常集中，全在石油石化、煤炭、保险、电力这几个大块头身上，跟题材没关系。

创业板的走势更说明问题：从+2.44%砍到+1.49%，回吐了四成涨幅，但没翻绿，还收在2495.29——离2500只差5个点。上方2500这条线，从10月下旬到现在反复验证过三次了，是实打实的压力位。

所以我上午给的判断是：这回高开回落，**不是没钱，是钱换了方向**。0跌停是很重要的信号，市场没恐慌，只是在换仓。

▪️ 对照一下盘前给的三条硬指标，兑现了几条

① 成交额——半日9603亿，全天预估1.56万亿。落在"1.5-1.7万亿磨盘分化"区间，没到1.75万亿的右侧确认线。判定：结构行情，不是趋势行情。**兑现，中性。**

② PCB和元件的量价——这条兑现得最漂亮。元件开盘半小时净流入25.59亿，是连续第二天为正；世运电路2连板、肯特+澳弘+协和涨停、迅捷兴+12%、沪电+7%。盘前说"业绩硬的板块资金不会只做一天"——今天就是第二天。**兑现。**

③ 国产算力 vs 英伟达链的分化——**方向反了，这条我认错。** 盘前预期是国产算力强、光模块弱；实际是光模块强（新易盛净买13亿全场第一、中际旭创+5.82%），国产算力反而萎（海光信息高开+3.8%缩到+0.08%，长鑫科技+3.8%缩到+1.30%）。

错在哪？我把英伟达当成费半的方向标了。实际隔夜费半30只成分股里29只涨、只有英伟达跌4.27%，A股跟的是"板块beta"，不是"英伟达alpha"。所以映射到光模块、存储、PCB，而不是国产替代逻辑。这个纠偏，今天就得记住。

▪️ 下午怎么走，两种剧本+一个激进版

**剧本A（五成）：权重继续拖，题材自己玩，沪指窄震3655-3680，创业板守2490。**
理由：①1.56万亿的量还不够让权重和题材同时涨，跷跷板会继续；②0跌停说明没有系统性风险，权重砸不动；③今晚21:30美国10月CPI，12月加息押注已经到80%，资金不敢重仓过夜，尾盘会有减仓盘；④创业板2500反复上不去，今天上不去也正常。
信号：14:00累计成交上不了1.15万亿、传媒高标不炸板、沪指不破3655。

**剧本B（三成）：红利止跌，钱从题材回流权重，指数反抽收红，创业板反而回落。**
理由：今天上午的杀跌全来自能源红利，而油价已经连跌两天，布油从105砸到92、跌了12%，这个位置的技術性反抽需求在积累。一旦中国石油跌幅收窄、煤炭翻红，分流到题材的钱会被抽回去——那时候要小心的是今天上午的**镜像版本：指数涨、账户不涨**。
信号：中国石油跌幅收窄到3%以内、煤炭板块翻红、沪指站回3670、创业板同时跌破2490。

**剧本C（两成）：下午放量上冲，创业板站上2500，沪指重回3680。**
理由：需要新钱。触发条件很具体——费半夜盘期货继续强、CPI公布前有抢跑资金、某个大块头（比如存储或半导体设备）午后突然放量涨停潮。
信号：14:00累计1.2万亿以上、涨停家数破70家、炸板率降到20%以下、创业板站上2500且14:30不回落。

**我押A，但把B看得比C重要。** 今天最真实的东西是那个"0跌停"——市场没恐慌，只是在换仓。换仓行情里指数最容易走成窄幅震荡，个股给机会。真正要防的风险不是大跌，是红利止跌之后题材被抽血，指数飘红而账户回撤。

▪️ 下午四个盯盘点，别看太多，盯这四个够

1. **14:00累计成交1.15万亿。** 这是分水岭：不到1.1万亿就是缩量磨，收在3660-3670；上1.2万亿才有反抽动能。
2. **创业板2490和2500。** 2490是今天上午的支撑带，跌破说明今天的钱在跑；站上2500且14:30不回落，C剧本才启动。
3. **传媒三个旗手：文投控股、华策影视、掌阅科技。** 只要有一个炸板不回封，明天传媒就是退潮第一天，这条线现在是靠情绪撑高度，不是靠业绩。
4. **中国石油和煤炭板块。** 权重能不能止跌的体温计。油价两天跌12%，反抽一旦起来，题材就得让位。

补一条：机器人这条线我给的权重比传媒高。宇树+10%市值3200亿、福莱新材6天3板创新高，产业催化+政策+海外映射三重齐备，这是今天唯一有"持续性"的品种。传媒是弹性最好但最容易退潮的，机器人是慢一点但更能走。别追已连板的，盯回踩。

最后一句：仓位这件事今天得算清楚——今晚21:30美国10月CPI，前置条件是10月非农16.5万超预期、12月加息预期升温。上午0跌停给了底气，但CPI会把这份底气重新定价。留点现金过夜，不是看空，是常识。

以上为个人观点，不构成投资建议。

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 got 20% cheaper today, and its token price is still 8x the price of GPT-6.1 Terra.
items.summary:
Claude Fable 5.2 got 20% cheaper today, and its token price is still 8x the price of GPT-6.1 Terra.

@AnthropicAI set Fable 5.2 at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, down from $10 and $50, while @OpenAI charges $1 and $5 for Terra.

Fable 5.2 needs a paid Claude plan or the API, and Anthropic points everyday work to Opus 5.5 at $4 and $20, which is half the Fable price.

Do you reserve the expensive model for hard jobs, or pay frontier rates for everything you run?

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. items.title: Jensen Huang is living proof that AI’s rockstar CEOs are also a hidden risk | CNN Business
items.summary:
Huang has also served as the AI industry’s ambassador on the international stage. He recently met with leaders in European capitals, pitching them on the idea of sovereign AI, where every country needs to build and control its own AI systems.

And Huang has presided over Nvidia’s effort to build out the AI ecosystem. In September, the company disclosed a staggering $99 billion worth of equity investments in this space, up from $2.2 billion two years ago. [...] President Donald Trump, left, and Open AI president Greg Brockman, right, listen as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks at the White House in Washington, DC, on September 29, 2026, after meeting with top executives of AI firms.

When worries about cheaper open models from China sparked selling in global markets, Huang teamed up with Wall Street power players to cobble together a $500 billion plan aimed at keeping the flow of money pumping into AI-powering chips. [...] While Nvidia’s most recent annual financial report to regulators does not directly spell out how much the company’s fate is linked to Huang, the filing does note the company is “highly dependent” on the services of its executive team. It also acknowledges that “failure to ensure effective succession planning” could “hinder our strategic planning, execution and long-term success.”

# Tin nóng công nghệ 9/11: iPhone Air 2 có thể được bổ sung camera thứ 2

13:36 09/11/2026

iPhone Air 2 có thể có camera thứ 2, Samsung hé lộ smartphone màn hình trượt, trong khi chuyên gia Tencent cảnh báo nguy cơ AI bị lợi dụng để phát triển vũ khí sinh học là những tin công nghệ đáng chú ý ngày 9/11.

Mục lục

Minh Qun

1. iPhone Air 2 có thể được bổ sung camera thứ 2 [...] Vivo đang phát triển mẫu điện thoại gập mới có màn hình nhỏ hơn 6,5 inch nhằm cạnh tranh với iPhone Duo và Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. Theo PhoneArena, thông tin bắt nguồn từ tài khoản Digital Chat Station trên mạng xã hội Weibo.

iPhone Air hiện còn một số hạn chế như chỉ có một loa, cổng USB 2 và tốc độ sạc thấp hơn dòng Pro. Theo 9to5Mac, những điểm yếu này có thể khiến người dùng cn nhắc khi giá bán gần bằng iPhone Pro.

items.title: I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop.
items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego
items.summary:
As districts consider their options, students are already seeing artificial intelligence become a more common part of everyday learning.

“I feel like I see a lot of people using AI now,” said Delilah Ortiz, a student at El Camino High School.

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. However, districts that want to continue using Google Search will have to opt in to the AI features.

items.title: Open source bug fixing using Fable 5.2? 🤔🤔
items.summary:
Open source bug fixing using Fable 5.2? 🤔🤔 

Here is a version you can post as is:

**Got leftover chatbot tokens at the end of the week? Here is one use for them.**

A lot of paid AI subscriptions come with a weekly allowance. Whatever I don't use by the end of the week is gone. So I started asking a simple question: what if the leftover allowance went toward helping strangers?

Here is the idea. Free public software is full of small open bug reports. Many of those reports sit for weeks because the people who maintain the software are volunteers with limited time. Lots of those bugs are small: a typo in a command name or a crash on a weird input or a wrong default value.

So I asked my AI model to do four things:

1. Find open bug reports in public projects that the maintainers labelled as good for beginners.
2. Pick only the small and clear ones. Skip anything that needs a judgment call by the maintainers.
3. Write a short fix and a test for each one.
4. Keep every note short so no volunteer gets buried in a wall of AI text.

In one evening the assistant wrote seven small fixes across six projects. The assistant also skipped eight other bug reports because those eight were unclear. I count the skipping as a feature: a sloppy fix costs a volunteer more time than no fix.

Where I got stuck: the assistant could write the fixes but could not send the fixes to the projects. A safety rule on the AI company's side blocked the assistant from posting to other people's projects under my account and from running the projects' own tests. So right now a human still has to do the sending. I don't know how to do the sending yet and I don't have the energy to learn tonight.

Why I'm posting:

- If you have leftover tokens each week then your leftover tokens could do the same thing.
- If you know how to submit fixes on GitHub then you are the missing piece. One person who knows the sending step could pair with many people who have spare tokens.
- If you maintain a public project then tell me what a welcome AI-written fix looks like to you. Short? Tested? Labelled as AI-written? I would rather ask than guess.

Unused tokens vanish every week. Open bug reports don't. I would like to connect the two.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI Backer Altimeter Targets $3B+ for Private Markets | November 10, 2026
items.summary:
OpenAI Backer Altimeter Targets $3B+ for Private Markets | November 10, 2026
📍Data From https://t.co/rtKhA53pFF Daily Report

Altimeter, an investor in OpenAI and Anthropic, is targeting $2.5B for a late-stage fund and reportedly discussing $800M–$900M for a separate fund focused on younger startups. That adds up to $3.3B–$3.4B in potential fundraising. The late-stage fund’s initial filing reported no sales as of November 9.

The number that matters is $2.5B. Roughly three-quarters of the proposed total is earmarked for later-stage companies. If the fund closes near target, it could give some companies more room to raise privately and wait for a better IPO window. It would also give Altimeter room to be selective on price and deal terms. Neither fund has announced a new investment in OpenAI or Anthropic.

The trader’s read: Watch what Altimeter actually raises, then how it deploys the money. A primary investment puts cash on a company’s balance sheet; a secondary purchase pays existing holders. The first can help fund hiring or compute. The second can support a valuation without adding a dollar to the company’s operating budget.

For listed AI suppliers, the stronger signal would be fresh funding that turns into signed compute contracts, infrastructure orders, or higher spending guidance. A fundraising target tells us what one manager hopes to raise. The terms and use of the money will tell us more about what investors are willing to pay for AI growth.
